title: A question about late payments, then a signature (offer agent only)
description: Starts at the offer phase: the application is set up as completed, without the application agent, and the bank sends the offer the customer asked for ($15,000 over 48 months). A day later she asks what happens if she pays late one month. The offer agent should look it up and answer from the bank's loan terms (a late fee of $25 if a payment is more than 15 days late), naming the source, and not from a CFPB answer about another product. Two days after that answer she signs the offer.
